name: relay-kit
description: Three read-only rituals that keep context alive across machines, tools and sessions: /afk (leave clean), /handoff (extract volatile memory), /yourturn (pick up).

config_path.title: Relay config path
config_path.description: Path to your per-repo relay config, relative to the repo root. Copy templates/relay.config.md there to enable project-aware handoffs.

repo_root.title: Fallback repo root
repo_root.description: Used only when a session starts outside a git repo. Leave empty to make the rituals ask instead of guessing.

vault_root.title: Notes vault root
vault_root.description: Optional. Where your daily journals live if they are NOT inside the repo (Obsidian vault, OneDrive folder, etc). Leave empty to keep journals in the repo.

journal_dir.title: Journal directory
journal_dir.description: Journal folder, relative to the vault root (or to the repo root if no vault is set). Files are written as <journal_dir>/YYYY-MM/YYYY-MM-DD.md.

handoff_dir.title: Handoff notes directory
handoff_dir.description: Where /handoff writes its notes, relative to the repo root. Keep it outside .claude/ — Claude Code treats that directory as protected, so writes there prompt for permission every time and fail outright in a non-interactive run. Notes are disposable working files; add this directory to .gitignore.
